evidence.threshold: IMGT framework >=0.90 AND CDR3 >=0.70 AND absolute CDR3 length difference <=2; exact integer arithmetic using retained repository contract.
evidence.ancestryRule: Known parent/variant and receptor-family evidence overrides a negative sequence threshold result.
evidence.metadataGraphCaveat: Whole-entry helper Nb35/NabFab and non-target VHH connections can join unrelated receptors. No global metadata component was silently reinterpreted as selected-target lineage; uncertain shared ancestry remains a limitation.

limitations: No exhaustive historical no-edge certificate. Negative VHH threshold results cannot certify independent ancestry.
